attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: opaque square seamless HD sky texture master, 6sky02.
Input image: the supplied 6sky02.png is the EDIT TARGET, not just a mood reference.
Primary request: faithfully restore this exact original Might and Magic 6 sky painting at the largest square output size available, preferably 2048 x 2048, at least 1024 x 1024. Repaint dithering, palette banding and blocky pixels as smooth hand-painted gradients and fine soft wisps, billows and subtle internal cloud shading. This is the same picture restored, not a new cloud arrangement.
Invariants: lock the input composition at identical normalized coordinates. Every cloud retains its exact position, size, silhouette and direction of flow. Keep the same cloud coverage, gaps, palette, lighting direction and mood. No clouds added, removed, rearranged, enlarged or shrunk. Keep the central dark blue branching gap, the tan cloud fields and the warm pale highlights exactly where they appear in the input.
Open sky: EVERY cloud-free gap must be one perfectly flat solid RGB(61,68,108), hex #3d446c, with no gradient, noise, haze, brush texture or variation. Clouds retain soft edges against this flat colour.
Cloud palette, brightest first: #b89e88, #917a6e, #746669, #57546d, #3d446c. Preserve the muted warm tan versus dusk-blue balance; do not brighten or saturate the original.
Tiling: paint a single seamless tile, periodic in both axes. The left edge continues into the right, and top into bottom, exactly as in the original; match cloud contours, colour and shading across each pair of opposite edges. No visible seam when repeated 2 x 2. Show just ONE tile, never a repeated grid.
Style: clean, detailed hand-painted game sky, softly blended natural cloud structure, no photographic look, no new grain or dither.
Canvas: opaque full bleed square, edge to edge, no margin.
Avoid: sun, moon, stars, rays, lens flare, horizon, ground, mountains, birds, buildings, text, logos, frames, borders, vignettes, watermarks.
attempts.reason: Rejected: sampled clear-sky RGB differs by 7–9 in at least one channel, exceeding the brief's ±6 tolerance. Composition and 2 x 2 tiling visually pass.

checks.composition_review: Same overall cloud layout, shape, scale and flow; fine details repainted.
